rootCause.detail: At a monthly rebalance the runner requested opening prices only for new target symbols. If an existing holding left the target set, rebalanceAtOpen valued that old holding with opens[symbol] undefined, producing NaN. JSON serialization converted NaN to null. Equal-weight9 was unaffected because it always retained all nine sectors.

changes: Rebalance opening-price request uses union(current holdings, new targets).
rebalanceAtOpen/liquidateAtOpen hard-fail on missing/non-finite prices and values.
runner hard-fails non-finite candidate/control/benchmark economic blocks before any gate.
result validity requires exact implementationRevision; old/no-revision result files are archived and recomputed.
monthly inference includes initial entry cost consistently for candidate and benchmarks.
automatic E2E runs the real runner on a rotation-heavy fixture and a forced-pass fixture that must open replication, bootstrap continuity and 80% classification.
Yahoo raw corporate-actions audit checks hashes, official 2025 split set and split-adjusted-OHLC continuity.
Yahoo 10-year adjusted-close CAGR must reconcile to State Street official NAV and market-value returns within ±0.20 pp/year for all nine sectors before the economic runner.

nextAction: NO_USER_ACTION_REQUIRED_DURING_R3_TECHNICAL_CLOSURE; exact local job is self-tested before any future real-data rerun.
